scope: the four wiring defects found around the identity fix, and what was changed for each

no_fallback_to_an_impersonatable_path.what_was_wrong: an install failure produced an overlay naming the stock client, which sends no caller identity; the console's add-Agent path took the same old route
no_fallback_to_an_impersonatable_path.change: the requirement now lives inside host_registration.register for this adapter, so every caller - CLI and console - passes one gate: the provider is ensured first, and an unavailable provider returns a failed registration instead of writing an overlay

declared_is_not_installed.what_was_wrong: package.json listing the package was read as ready, even with nothing to resolve
declared_is_not_installed.change: readiness is the resolved directory profiles/<app>/node_modules/<package>/package.json; the same check runs again after an install, and an unverified install is reported rather than assumed

initialization_instructions.what_was_wrong: the provider dropped the server's initialization instructions, losing the inbox, task-flow and permission guidance from the host
initialization_instructions.change: the initialize result is kept and published as the mcp:<server> prompt section
initialization_instructions.measured: the bridge publishes 340 characters; one section registered, text length 340

spawn_errors.what_was_wrong: a bridge command that does not exist emitted an unhandled error event and took the host process down
spawn_errors.change: the child's error event rejects the pending calls with mcp_spawn_failed and marks the transport closed
spawn_errors.measured: apply rejected with mcp_spawn_failed:spawn ... ENOENT; process alive, no uncaught exception

verified_this_round.unit: 56 passed across the deepseek registration, registration, console-project and CLI suites
verified_this_round.provider_module_direct: instructions section present, spawn failure contained, 43 tools registered with identity key tsunagou.hostSessionId

not_yet_verified: the four-way real host acceptance: original session, borrowed overlay, new fork, fork independently enrolled
A -> B -> A identity switching inside one host process
a shortest main/worker task and message loop on the new wiring
compact before/after under the new wiring
conclusion: the core identity fix stands and the four wiring defects are repaired; the round stays unaccepted until the real host acceptance above is run
